name: grail-layers
purpose: The one distro for everything new, on the unchanged grail. Layers applied in memory (the supervisor probes /chat and falls back to plain grail on any failure): providers (Responses-API models like gpt-6.1-sol, plus this machine's Ollama models) and journal_tap (every chat turn recorded in your Brainstem Journal). Agents: Journal Recall (find earlier conversations, pause recording) and Fragments (paste once, address by hash, pin into every chat). Use it from the llm CLI with github.com/kody-w/llm-brainstem.

parts.what: The one provider part: Responses-API-only models (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna) and this machine's Ollama models (ollama/<name>, tools included) in the unchanged grail. responses_models and local_models are aliases of this part (status: alias; still served, not seeded). Since 1.1: topics the owner marks private (Private Mode pack) are answered by a local model or refused, never sent out.
Models that only speak the Responses API (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna) become usable in the unchanged grail.
Every chat turn (plain and streamed) is recorded in the Brainstem Journal on this device, by default; pause it from chat. No journal running: nothing happens.
Models running on this machine (Ollama, http://127.0.0.1:11434) join the model list as ollama/<name> and answer chat with tools, no Copilot needed for them. No Ollama: nothing changes.

A whole Brainstem whose kernel is LisPy (lispy-core@1) in ONE file: lisp.py 0.26.0, its stdlib, brainstem.lispy and the thin host, sha-pinned and unpacked into a hash-keyed folder. Passes the same 25-scenario grail oracle. Replaces brainstem.py for the shape it is in; your agents, soul and data follow.

Senses and pages over the unchanged grail. A sense adds one extra field to every plain chat reply (a headline, a short version); a page adds a read-only view at /api/<name>/ (GET only; every change goes through /chat, rapp/1 section 8). Senses and pages hot-load like agents/: add, change or remove the file and the next request sees it, no restart. Before this, only rappter-distro's own kernel loaded them; that loader is now an alias of this part. Organ is an alias of page.

install.parts_note: rapp-rar-stack/1.2: `parts` is the current list (publisher-scoped ids, kind layer|kernel, one point each, sha256 + locator; the installer seeds the device's rapp/1 chain from it). `layers`, `default_enabled` and `proven_grail` are kept as an alias of `parts` for older installers; status: alias, retiring when a measured check shows zero readers. `seed` (1.2.1) names the parts the installer seeds; the rest are published for "update my brainstem with …".
